question: What claim about the speaker's desire is at stake in wishing to hear about the worship of the siddhas from the gurus now?
premises: The speaker wishes to hear now.
The object of hearing is the worship of the siddhas.
The source of hearing is the gurus.
inference: The speaker now desires to learn the worship of the siddhas directly from the gurus.
plain_english: Now I wish to hear from the gurus about the worship of the siddhas.
